test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As per the findings of the 2011 census, which is the most thickly populated State (excluding Union territories) in India?
solution:
The correct answer is **Bihar**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bihar** is the most thickly populated state in India as per the 2011 census.
 
• The population density of Bihar is approximately **1102 persons per square kilometer**.
 
• This high density is due to a combination of factors including high birth rates and relatively small land area.
 
• Other states like Uttar Pradesh have large populations but lower population density compared to Bihar.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Goa
 Goa is one of the least populated states and has a much lower population density.
 
 

 Uttar Pradesh
 Uttar Pradesh has the largest population but a lower population density (828 persons per square kilometer) compared to Bihar.
 
 

 Tamil Nadu
 Tamil Nadu has a moderate population density of 555 persons per square kilometer.
